title: Code and data for Regime-adaptive branch decisions for deficient-order fits of spectral clusters
description: Code and simulation data for a statistical branch-decision method for deficient-order spectral fits: linear and restricted-cost tests, regime selection, 196,000 original-study records, 36,000 fixed follow-up draws, matched-error comparisons, spacing/tuning checks and figure generators. This is the statistical-method study, separate from the deterministic companion and its interval-certificate archive (10.5281/zenodo.23451747). Code is MIT-licensed; data, figures and documentation are CC BY 4.0 as specified in LICENSE-DATA.md.
